Vat.GhiChu: Nghi dinh 174/2025/ND-CP (30/6/2025): hang/dich vu dang chiu 10% giam con 8% tu 01/07/2025 den het 31/12/2026, tru nhom Phu luc I (vien thong, tai chinh, ngan hang, chung khoan, bao hiem, BDS, san pham kim loai, san pham khai khoang tru than) va Phu luc II (hang chiu thue TTDB tru xang). Cac rule 8% duoi day CHUA doi chieu tung mat hang theo ma HS voi Phu luc I/II (DaXacMinh=false, NEEDS_TAX_REVIEW) — khong dung lam can cu ke khai thue that. Ngoai cua so hieu luc hoac khong co rule rieng: 10%.
